en_title: Star Wars Zero Company Estimated to Have Sold 1 Million, With Nearly 70% on Steam
cn_title: 《星球大战》《Star Wars Zero Company》估售百万份，近七成来自Steam
subtitle: Steam占了大头
opus_summary: 分析师估计，《Star Wars Zero Company》已售出100万份，其中69.9%来自Steam，推出以来收入约5000万美元(约合人民币3亿元)(人民币换算待核实)。EA尚未公布官方销量，也未评论其商业表现。

paragraphs.en: Star Wars Zero Company is estimated to have sold 1 million copies, with the majority of those sales coming from Steam.
paragraphs.cn: 据估计，《星球大战 零号连队》已售出100万份，其中大部分销量来自Steam。

paragraphs.en: Alinea Analytics' Rhys Elliott took to social media to discuss the performance of Bit Reactor’s Star Wars strategy game, which was developed by former developers of XCOM at Firaxis.
paragraphs.cn: Alinea Analytics的Rhys Elliott在社交媒体上谈到了Bit Reactor这款《星球大战》策略游戏的表现。参与开发的人员曾在Firaxis参与《XCOM》的开发。

paragraphs.en: 69.9% of those 1 million sales came from Steam, with 19.9% on PlayStation, and 10.2% on Xbox / Xbox PC. Clearly, Steam is where it’s at for Zero Company, which Elliott estimates has generated around $50 million since last month’s launch.
paragraphs.cn: 在这100万份销量中，Steam占69.9%，PlayStation占19.9%，XBOX及XBOX PC占10.2%。显然，Steam是《星球大战 零号连队》销量的主要来源。Elliott估计，游戏自上个月推出以来，收入约为5000万美元(约合人民币3亿元)(人民币换算待核实)。

paragraphs.en: This performance, Elliott said, is “respectable for this genre and during such a crowded period (even with the Star Wars brand attached).”
paragraphs.cn: Elliott表示，「考虑到游戏类型和同期作品众多，即便有《星球大战》品牌加持，这样的表现也算不错。」

paragraphs.en: But does it meet publisher EA’s expectations? The company has yet to issue official sales figures for Zero Company or comment on its commercial performance. Now EA has gone private, it is under no obligation to share revenue figures with the market, so it’s unlikely we’ll find out.
paragraphs.cn: 但这是否达到了发行商EA的预期？EA尚未公布《星球大战 零号连队》的官方销量，也没有评论其商业表现。如今EA已私有化，无须向市场披露营收数据，因此我们恐怕难以得知答案。

paragraphs.en: What we do know is that Bit Reactor furloughed "many of its workers" before Zero Company even came out as it reportedly had "run out of most of its money just ahead of the launch of its first game." Bit Reactor told Game File it was a "difficult decision" made "before it was clear how the launch would go," insisting it was not influenced by EA or Star Wars rights holder Disney. Game File reported that 80% of Bit Reactor’s staff were furloughed, leaving a skeleton crew to address any post-launch bugs for Zero Company.
paragraphs.cn: 可以确定的是，Bit Reactor在《星球大战 零号连队》发售前就让「许多员工」停薪留职。据报道，这家工作室「在首款游戏发售前夕，资金已所剩无几」。Bit Reactor告诉Game File，这是在「尚不清楚游戏上市后表现如何」时作出的「艰难决定」，并强调EA和《星球大战》版权方迪士尼都没有影响这一决定。Game File报道称，Bit Reactor有80%的员工停薪留职，只留下少数人处理《星球大战 零号连队》发售后的程序错误。

paragraphs.en: “It's SO GOOD, but it's niche,” Elliott added. “One thing limiting Zero Company’s sales, as with many Star Wars games, is that it’s only really popular in the West. Of Zero Company’s players, 90% are in North America or Europe, with under 5% in Asia.
paragraphs.cn: Elliott补充道：「游戏真的非常好，但受众比较小。和许多《星球大战》游戏一样，限制《星球大战 零号连队》销量的一个因素是，它实际上只在西方市场受欢迎。游戏玩家中，90%来自北美或欧洲，亚洲玩家占比不到5%。」

paragraphs.en: “On Steam, the Chinese user reviews sit at 57% positive (versus an 82% global average), with many pointing to the lack of VO and localisation options. Star Wars has never had the pull in Asia that it has in the West, of course. But skipping proper localisation compounds that.”
paragraphs.cn: 「在Steam上，中文用户评测的好评率为57%，而全球平均好评率为82%。许多评论指出，游戏缺少配音和本地化选项。当然，《星球大战》在亚洲的吸引力从未达到它在西方的水平。但缺乏完善的本地化，让情况更加严重。」

paragraphs.en: What happens next? The latest Zero Company patch was released on September 10, but we haven’t heard from the studio since.
paragraphs.cn: 接下来会怎样？《星球大战 零号连队》的最新补丁于9月10日发布，但此后工作室一直没有新的消息。

paragraphs.en: IGN's Star Wars Zero Company review returned a 9/10. We said: "Star Wars Zero Company is an excellent tactical game that does a fantastic job of slathering on the same cinematic look and feel we saw in Respawn's Star Wars Jedi games, incorporating strong characters and a storyline that's refreshingly centered on non-Force users and a non-traditional villain."
paragraphs.cn: IGN给《星球大战 零号连队》打出了9分（满分10分）。我们在评测中写道：「《星球大战 零号连队》是一款出色的战术游戏。它很好地呈现了Respawn《星球大战绝地》系列那种电影般的观感，同时塑造了鲜明的角色；剧情聚焦于非原力使用者和一位非传统反派，也令人耳目一新。」
